steps.action: Register on the Karnataka state scholarship portal (and the Vidyasiri portal if separate) and create login credentials.

Visit the college scholarship cell to verify the unverified rules for Vidyasiri (SC inclusion, 40% marks, year‑1, income limit), Post‑Tech (SC diploma eligibility), Post‑Arya (Arya Vyshya only), and Post‑Brahmin (Brahmin only).

If Vidyasiri and Post‑Tech eligibility are confirmed, submit their applications before the 31 Oct deadline, uploading caste certificate, income certificate, Aadhaar, mark sheet, bank details, and photo.
Apply for caste and income certificates at the local Nadakacheri/tahsildar office (these can take several weeks).
Complete and submit the Post‑Matric (Social Welfare) application with the 15‑digit RD number, UDID if applicable, and e‑attestation.
If the college confirms an exception, submit the Post‑Arya application.

plan.summary: The Post‑Matric Scholarship from the Social Welfare Department is the most reliable option with a comfortable deadline, but you must obtain caste and income certificates soon. The Vidyasiri and Technical Education scholarships close in two days, so confirm eligibility today and apply immediately if you qualify.
